capabilities: fork AI conversation branches from any Canvas node with direction labels
continue chats with context inherited along the ancestor chain
configure multiple OpenAI-compatible models with colors, icons and system prompts
merge branches and replay the conversation tree
export conversation trees as Markdown or interactive single-file HTML
extras: Install is manual (download release) or build from source; no community plugin store listing is described. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs are bilingual (Chinese/English) and a roadmap lives in PLAN.md.
intentEvidence: This is not "yet another AI chat plugin" — Obsidian already has Text Generator and Copilot.
motivation: The author states the real value is 'turning conversations into navigable thinking maps' rather than adding another chat interface.
problem: AI chat plugins carry on a single linear thread, so exploring several angles of a question loses the structure of earlier branches.

summary: Canvas plugin that runs branching AI conversations, forking new question threads from any node with inherited context and Markdown or HTML export.
